original-johto.flavorText: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw arou­ nd an object that is 100 times its own weight.

hoenn.flavorText: They gather in forests seeking the sweet sap of trees. It is completely clad in a steel-hard shell. It is proud of its horn, which it uses to fling foes.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: With powerful legs and claws, it generates enough power to hurl foes over great distances.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

updated-johto.flavorText: It is usually docile, but if it is disturbed while sipping honey, it chases off the intruder with its horn.

original-unova.flavorText: It loves sweet honey. To keep all the honey to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

updated-unova.flavorText: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

kalos.flavorText: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Heracross has sharp claws on its feet. These are planted firmly into the ground or the bark of a tree, giving the Pokémon a secure and solid footing to forcefully fling away foes with its proud horn.

updated-alola.flavorText: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it’s not that good at flying.

swsh.flavorText: This Pokémon takes pride in its strength, which allows it to lift things 100 times heavier than itself with no trouble at all.
